description: This file defines a Pinia store for managing a wishlist in a frontend shopping application. It manages wishlist items, provides actions to add, remove, toggle, clear, move items to cart, and handles local storage persistence.
external_files: useUiStore (assumed external store for UI notifications)
useCartStore (assumed external store for shopping cart management)

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a product to the wishlist if it doesn't already exist, then shows a success notification.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a product from the wishlist by product ID and shows a success notification.

methods.name: toggleItem
methods.description: Toggles a product's presence in the wishlist.

methods.name: clearWishlist
methods.description: Clears all wishlist items and shows a notification.

methods.name: isInWishlist
methods.description: Checks if a product ID exists in the wishlist.

methods.name: moveToCart
methods.description: Moves an item from the wishlist to the cart.

methods.name: saveToStorage
methods.description: Persists the wishlist items to localStorage.

methods.name: loadFromStorage
methods.description: Loads the wishlist items from localStorage on startup.
